landing_page.hero: Split screen: Left text (Serif Heading), Right 3D/Abstract Visual. Minimalist.
landing_page.features: Bento Grid (Mode A: Tetris Grid). Mix of large visuals and small text blocks.
landing_page.matrix_section: Full-width dark section. Terminal aesthetic. Live counters.

funamatics_retro.usage: Funamatics section hero or card background

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a 'Modern Academic' platform. Think Ivy League meets Silicon Valley. Use the 'Playfair Display' font for all H1-H3 headings to give it that prestigious feel. Use 'Manrope' for body text for high readability.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_handling: Implement a dark mode toggle. Default to Light Mode for the main site, but the 'Matrix' page/section should ALWAYS be dark mode (terminal style) regardless of the global theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for smooth page transitions. The Matrix section should have a 'typing effect' for text and 'pulse' effect for stats.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn UI for the 'Resource Hub' tables and 'Auth' forms. Customize them to remove the default 'Vercel' look - add more border-radius (rounded-xl) and softer shadows.
instructions_to_main_agent.matrix_special: The Matrix section is unique. It should look like a digital dashboard. Use a monospace font (JetBrains Mono) for numbers and labels in this section only.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use subtle noise textures or solid colors.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state that changes color or scale.
Use 'data-testid' on all buttons and inputs.
Avoid centering text in long paragraphs. Left align for readability.
Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary.
